title: Gravebound: a browser bullet-hell RPG built in 48 hours.
author: BlinkETH
selftext:
Hey all! 

Just pushed out my first public game for a hackathon: **Gravebound**, a 3D voxel-style bullet-hell RPG inspired by games like Realm of the Mad God.

**Here's the workflow:**

* **Worlds³:** My own game engine, which handled most of the heavy lifting when it comes to gameplay, game-feel, optimisation. (open sourcing very soon)
* **Claude Opus 5.5:** Orchestration, running 24/7 during the game jam.
* **Fable 5.2:** Most of the visuals and game feel.
* **GPT-6.2 Astra:** Optimisation and research.
* **Gemini + fal:** Visual concepts and mockups.
* **Meshy + fal:** 3D asset generation.
* **ElevenLabs:** Audio.
* **An ungodly amount of prompting and tokens + good prompting.**

Aside from a handful of 3D models I'd accumulated over the years, pretty much everything was AI-generated.

I also tried to squeeze multiplayer into the 48 hours, but unfortunately ran out of time. It's something I plan to add later.

It's probably full of bugs, the UX needs a lot of work, and there are plenty of things I'd change given more time.

But that's also part of the challenge. I've stopped making changes and submitted it exactly as it is.

🧵 [Thread of the tools is here too. ](https://x.com/addo_xyz/status/2123747840740757694?a=vw3QF-2bsVW4Qio5DNI&s=20)

🎮 [Play it here. ](https://opengame.io/@addo/gravebound)

I was just running around trying to survive with no way to play my character in. Need to make the player feel a lot more powerful at the start.
